description.la: Libellus de disciplina claustralium: in quibus consistit disciplina claustralis, silentium, officium divinum, opus manuum, oboedientia, correctio.
description.en-US: Sixteen chapters on the discipline of the cloister: silence, the divine office, manual work, obedience, correction and fidelity to the rule. Latin only: Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1904), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; no public-domain English translation has been found.
description.pt-BR: Dezesseis capítulos sobre a disciplina do claustro: silêncio, ofício divino, trabalho manual, obediência, correção e fidelidade à regra.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis De disciplina claustralium, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1904), Opera omnia II; archive.org raw OCR.
sources.description: Pohl's text without his critical apparatus and introduction; line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script, upper-case chapter titles recased (u/v normalised by script). Raw OCR: drop capitals at openings are often garbled and some slips remain after the scripted lexicon repair.
